existing_proofs_preserved: Both complete streamed passes, all row outputs, masked accesses and frame are proved. The current typed source uses libdevice pow with integer exponent 2, preserving the original operation rather than only the legacy multiplication model. All 216 floating input/weight/output profiles retain fp32 conversion/powi/accumulation and fp64 weight widening; typed_real_correct and the index-only source equivalence remain credited.

production_stage_mapping.coverage: Both loops over arbitrary positive B and row length N are covered, including partial final blocks.
Rank/weight-shape check, output allocation and batch-by-M launch are not connected by a wrapper theorem.

dtype_review: Storage lists six floating types and Precision.computation_profiles accounts for all 216 combinations. Python only checks rms_w.shape[-1]==K; nonfloating input/weight/output storage and its exact admission behavior are outside this finite formal family.
branch_review: Loop extent and tail masks are already parametric; BLOCK_N_SIZE=1024 is included. The weight-shape assertion success/failure and full batch/M grid belong to the uncomposed wrapper. No pow-versus-multiply omission is charged against the current typed public theorem.

structural_gaps.finding: The wrapper checks weight width, allocates out and launches (batch,M), but public ExactIO describes one pid pair and its streamed row.
structural_gaps.why_blocks_full_original_scope: The existing row theorem has not been composed into the returned tensor and the actual wrapper shape-check behavior.

structural_gaps.finding: The public typed API uses a six-constructor Storage for each input, weight and output; original Python has no such dtype restriction.
structural_gaps.why_blocks_full_original_scope: Additional admitted conversion/promotion/store routes or precise rejection cases must be represented before the original dtype domain is complete.

numerical_items_eligible_for_explicit_de: Native powi, fp32 sum/division/rsqrt, weight multiplication and casts may be deferred at exact registered profiles. typed_real_correct is exact-real erased-dtype execution, not native numerical validation.
precondition_assessment: The existing bounds, nonoverlap, positive tile size and valid-address premises are legitimate selected-domain assumptions. No unrestricted invalid-input behavior or hypothetical hardware defect is demanded. Missing wrapper composition and dtype admission are separate structural questions.
